system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Engineering

As an Action, you may make a Mind (Engineering) check to repair Armor in combat — yours or an ally's.

The DC of the check depends on the Rarity of the armor.

  • Common: 4:1

  • Uncommon: 5:1

  • Rare / Unique: 6:1

If you succeed, you restore 1 Armor for each success, up to the armor's original rating.

Once a set of armor has been repaired this way, it cannot benefit from this ability again until it has been properly restored in a workshop.
